name: arcade-pixel
title: Arcade Pixel
description: A black arcade screen draws messages in a chunky 5x7 pixel font on canvas, with space-invader sprites, typing and marquee animations, phosphor glow, scanlines and a faint CRT flicker.
use: A game, event or playful landing page wants the look of an old arcade screen with animated pixel text.
avoid: Canvas text is not selectable or searchable, and everything is sized in pixel cells rather than CSS type.
a11y: The message is exposed as hidden text and reduced motion freezes it, but the canvas art itself is aria-hidden. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A black rounded panel holding pixel art: three small glowing sprites along the top, a green alien, a pink cat and a yellow heart, then large pink blocky letters, a line of cyan scrolling text and white INSERT COIN beneath.
behaves: The big message types itself out letter by letter with a white flash on each new glyph, the cyan score line slides sideways continuously, and INSERT COIN blinks on and off over scanlines and a soft flicker.
customise: Text or a sprite grid, palette, pixel size, gap, columns, animation, speed, loop, glow, scanlines and CRT are all props. The 5x7 font and built-in sprites are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: A small 2D canvas repaints each frame for the marquee and blink, but pauses offscreen.
demo: The words GAME OVER, a HIGH SCORE 098400 PLAYER 1 ticker and INSERT COIN, plus alien and heart sprites.
issues: Several effects run at once, so the big title competes with the score ticker and blinking line.
polishWhy: Authentic arcade look with a custom pixel font and CRT layers; several effects at once feel busy.
